name: American Robin
mark: Look for the orange breast and pale eye ring. Watch it pause between short runs on the grass.

name: Great Blue Heron
mark: Long legs, a folded neck, and a straight bill make a distinctive silhouette in shallow water.

name: Belted Kingfisher
mark: Scan branches over water for a shaggy crest, slate-blue back, and a broad white collar.

name: Barn Owl
mark: The pale, heart-shaped face stands out against a warm, mottled back.
